Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses INSTRUCTIONS TO BIDDER (a) Bidder has to quote total lump sum contract value including GST as per scope of work and qua ntity as per clause 2 of ATC-GEM/2024/B/QND/WC/02. For this item, applicable GST rate@18% and Cess rate @Zero% for GST registered firm/bidder. As cess is not applicable to this item, h ence it is mandatory to quote Cess rate @Zero%. Quotation of Cess rate other than @Zero% is liable to be rejected at any stage of tend er even after price bid opening. In case GST rate applicable to any bidder is different (i.e. from GST @18%), then documentary evidence along with 8-digit SAC/HSN co de in support of quoted applicable rate to be provided by the bidde r. Non-submission of documentary evidence for quoted rate of GST, the bid is liable to be rejected at any stage of tender even after pri ce bid opening. Note: Conditions at clause a(i) and a(ii) above shall be applicable for ITC ba sed evaluation on GeM only. In cases where ITC based evaluation is not opt ed on GeM, clause a(i) and a(ii) shall not be applicable (b) MP government minimum wages for the skilled, semi-skilled and Unskilled is to be considere d as per table given below. Type of Worker MP Govt. recommended Minimum wages w.e.f. 01-04-2026 Skilled Rs. 582.00 per day without GST Semi- Skilled Rs. 516.00 per day without GST Un- Skilled Rs. 478.00 per day without GST

The above rates revised by BHEL HR(CLC) in every month of April and October in a year. Cont ractor shall ensure the payment of statutory minimum wages recommended by BHEL and PF, E SI, Contribution to Labour Welfare Board and bonus as per statutory requirements” as per Mini mum wage circular issued by BHEL HR(CLC)”. (c) Before tendering, the tenderer is advised to inspect the site of work and the environment an d be acquainted with the actual working and other prevalent conditions, facilities available etc. No claim will be entertained later on grounds of lack of knowledge. Bidder are also advised to r ead thoroughly all the clauses of the tenders and understand the same before tender is submit ted. (d) Prior to quoting his rates, the tenderer may visit the factory area / site to get acquainted in person with the existing installations/establishments/facilities and to ascertain for himself the q uantum and nature of work involved. Offer should be submitted keeping in mind all the factors and related incidental expenditure. No claim will be entertained later on any ground. BHEL will not pay any extra charges after acceptance of the contract even if it is found later that the Bid der has misjudged the nature and scope of work. (e) In case of any query/doubt on the tender specifications, bidder shall contact the concerned authority for clarification before tender submission. No condition/deviation w.r.t. terms & condi tions of the tender are acceptable. (f) Detailed information regarding bidding document if required can be obtained from Sh. Manis h Kumar (Phone 0755-2502649, Mob: 7587571047 email: manishkumar1@bhel.in) and Shri Ku mar Aditya Ranjan, (Phone 0755-2502143, Mob : 9395571945, email: adityaranjan@bhel.in) b etween 10 AM to 4 PM on all working days (g) Each page of the offer shall be duly signed by an authorised person of agency, with all form alities. (h) Bids lower than Rs 36,67,676 including GST for the tender shall be rejected. .
